ItemsQuoted.description: The ItemsQuoted container displays all quoted items with product details, quantities, pricing, and negotiated discounts for an active quote.

ItemsQuotedTemplate.description: The ItemsQuotedTemplate container displays items stored in a quote template for reuse in future quote requests.

ManageNegotiableQuote.description: The ManageNegotiableQuote container provides the main interface for managing a negotiable quote including status, actions, and quote details.

ManageNegotiableQuoteTemplate.description: The ManageNegotiableQuoteTemplate container provides the interface for managing quote templates with template-specific actions and details.

OrderSummary.description: The OrderSummary container displays the pricing summary including subtotal, discounts, taxes, and grand total for a quote.

OrderSummaryLine.description: The OrderSummaryLine container renders individual line items within the order summary such as subtotal, shipping, or tax rows.

QuoteCommentsList.description: The QuoteCommentsList container displays all comments and communications between buyer and seller for a negotiable quote.

QuoteHistoryLog.description: The QuoteHistoryLog container shows the complete history of actions, status changes, and updates for a quote throughout its lifecycle.

QuoteSummaryList.description: The QuoteSummaryList container displays quote metadata including quote ID, status, dates, buyer information, and shipping details.

QuoteTemplateCommentsList.description: The QuoteTemplateCommentsList container displays all comments associated with a quote template.

QuoteTemplateHistoryLog.description: The QuoteTemplateHistoryLog container shows the complete history of changes and updates for a quote template.

QuoteTemplatesListTable.description: The QuoteTemplatesListTable container displays all quote templates in a paginated table with search, filter, and action capabilities.

QuotesListTable.description: The QuotesListTable container displays all quotes in a paginated table with filtering, sorting, and action buttons for quote management.

RequestNegotiableQuoteForm.description: The RequestNegotiableQuoteForm container provides a form for requesting new negotiable quotes with product selection and initial details.

ShippingAddressDisplay.description: The ShippingAddressDisplay container shows the selected shipping address for a quote with options to change or add new addresses.
